learned_rules:
- **MIGRATED: buy the pullback, not the high.** Enter only 20–60% off the local high, while price holds above the hourly low, with 5m volume ≥ $10k and more buys than sells (V1, V6). Both winners came in this way: CATBOT, and FLOATER 34% off its high. MIGRATED is my only setup with a winner, so it gets first claim on the risk budget.
- **No buys within ~20% of the local high, even with clean bundles.** SI had 0.65% bundles and lost 38% in 7 min. CATCULUS dropped to -59% after a near-high entry. Near-high skips: 1 ran, 6 dumped.
- **Fresh migration (<1h) going red off the bond spike: wait for a base above the hourly low** (V1). Too-new skips: 3 ran, 11 dumped.
- **Vamp field: buy only the leader** by 5m volume and attention, never the 2nd or 3rd copy (V1, V2). FLOATER beat 22 same-ticker copies.
- **The target has to clear initials.** Before buying, name the level I expect it to retest (prior high, POC, 0.618). If that level is under 1.5x from entry, the exit can't pay: pass, or probe only. SWAN topped at exactly its named 1.40x and closed flat.
- **DIP needs a higher low I can see in the data:** a bounce off the hourly low, a pullback that holds above it, and price now above that pullback low. Never buy the first red-to-green candle (V1). If the higher low is more than ~20% below entry, I'm too far up the bounce: pass.
- **DIP attention gate: 5m volume ≥ 1x the hourly average and rising, plus a current narrative with a real crowd.** Under 1x is a pass, with no probe band. Weak, LARP or tech-story dips are a pass. Dips recover on attention, not on holder tables (Soul belief 7, V1).
- **DIP is on probation:** 0 for 3, -$3.07. Probe size only (conviction 5–6) until a DIP trade closes green.
- **Hack stories: pass.** That covers coins whose project got hacked and coins riding a hack headline (hack tickers, exploit plays, Hack Inu copies). They tend to bleed (owner note).
- **A RugCheck "danger" flag that isn't a hard line costs 1 conviction point. It doesn't cap the trade.** Name the flag, then size from the lower conviction. Its skips: 3 ran, 4 dumped, 1 flat.
- **Hard blocks stay:** top 10 >25%, dev >1%, bundles/insiders over the line, mint/freeze, LP, political figure (V6, V13, V17). Their skips mostly dumped: top 10 1 ran/11 dumped, dev 1/5, bundles 1/3.
- **Before initials: if I'm green and 5m volume drops to half its hourly pace, sell half.** CPU and FLOAT both reached ~1.6x, faded, and closed red.
- **Time stop: still under 1.0x at 45 min with no volume surge means exit, with no extensions** (V1). FLOAT was held to 158 min and still lost.
- **Stop review: SELL** if the trade never went green and hit the stop in under 15 min (bad entry: SI, HEXN), or if top-10/insider share dropped and price keeps bleeding. Hold once only if the narrative and 5m volume are clearly intact, with a deadline to reclaim.
- **Re-enter a stopped coin only when it reclaims the prior high,** never mid-range. The CATBOT buy-back from the middle of the range lost 24%.
